basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old student from Vancouver, Canada, currently diving into the world of Reddit. I have a strong interest in understanding social dynamics and how people interact in different settings, which aligns with my psychology studies. I enjoy collecting diecast models as a hobby and often find myself browsing through related subreddits. My typical online hours are in the late evenings, after classes and study sessions. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my downtime exploring new interests on the internet.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mostly stems from my undergraduate studies in psychology, where I focus on social behavior and group dynamics. I also have a casual interest in collectibles, particularly diecast models, which I explore through self-teaching and community exchanges.
